channel.title: Car and Driver - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Car and Driver (caranddriver.com)

item.title: View Exterior Photos of the 2026 Toyota bZ Woodland
item.description: See the exterior of the 2026 Toyota bZ Woodland from every angle.

item.title: 2026 Toyota bZ Woodland Gives Toyota's EV a More Wagon-Like Shape
item.description: The Woodland is essentially a longer and more powerful sibling of the existing bZ electric SUV.

item.title: See Images from the Tech Briefing on Ford's 2028 Electric Pickup
item.description: See photos shared by Ford's team as they prepare to build a clean-sheet-of-paper mid-size electric truck.

item.title: Ford's New 2028 Electric Truck Will Be a Fully Modern EV for $30,000
item.description: After a string of EVs adapted from other projects, Detroit’s second-largest maker has finally started with a clean sheet of paper.

item.title: Mercedes Reimagined the Iconic 'Red Pig' but Kept It in the Dark
item.description: This design concept never progressed beyond renderings, but it serves as a homage to a legendary race car and wears striking styling.

item.title: 2026 Ram 1500 Rebel X Returns with Exclusive Off-Road Cruise Control
item.description: Ram revisits the unique Rebel package, which also introduces a new green paint color and starts at nearly $72,000.

item.title: Audi Will Build the Concept C, Even If Porsche Cancels the 718 EV
item.description: In a letter to employees, Audi's CEO reaffirmed the brand's commitment to producing an electric sports car using a platform developed with Porsche.

item.title: Hyundai Recalls Some 2026 Kona SUVs for Faulty Steering Knuckles
item.description: The recall involves 4555 copies of Hyundai's subcompact SUV, which are at risk of potentially losing steering control.
